notes.en: First release: Google's four foundational machine-learning courses (Intro to ML, Machine Learning Crash Course, Problem Framing, Managing ML Projects) in English and Chinese, usable offline.
notes.zh: 第一版：Google 四门机器学习基础课程（机器学习简介、机器学习速成课程、问题构建、管理机器学习项目），中英对照，可离线使用。

notes.en: Key takeaways for each lesson, a recap card for each module, 'Check your understanding' questions you can answer in the app, and an 'I've mastered this' checklist.
notes.zh: 每课的「必会知识点」、每个单元的复习卡、可以直接作答的「检查您的理解情况」题目，以及「我已掌握」进度。

notes.en: Interactive figures you drag with a finger, the full ML glossary, flashcards, search in both languages, highlights, notes, bookmarks and a notes backup.
notes.zh: 可以用手指拖动的互动图、完整的机器学习术语表、闪卡、中英搜索、画线、笔记、书签和笔记备份。
